items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: So he came around by my house. I was living on St. Philip Street. And the fella named, we call him Bozoom.

ctx.x: Yeah, we started. Somebody told me he started as a drummer.

That's right, he was a pretty good drummer. I was surprised that one night we wasn't playing. So he came around by my house. I was living on St. Philip Street. And the fella named, we call him Bozoom. He said, all right, you ain't doing nothing like that.
